testimonials.text: Whilst on holiday with my two  collie dogs I found that the female, Freya, was very quiet which is very out of character as she’s the livelier of the two.  I asked Jennie to come and see Freya to see if she could help and do a reiki session.  Freya seemed to enjoy the session and was completely relaxed during it and within a few days she was back to her normal cheeky and energetic self.  Thank you Jennie for helping. Regards Jackie F
testimonials.author: Jackie
